subject: Two meetings, one attendee — resolution and handback plan

From: Peter Chen <peter.chen@lighthousehealth.com>

Cc: Lina Morales <lina@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the quick reply earlier. Lina and I are available next Tue 11am PT or Thu 2pm PT for the walkthrough. We prefer a short 35-minute session focused on inference cost controls and private deployment options.

If either of those is good for you, I can accept a calendar invite. Also happy to include our infra lead if we need deeper sys-arch questions.

Best,
Peter Chen
Director of Platform Engineering
Lighthouse Health

(attachment: Lighthouse_RFP.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Pete — great, thanks. I tentatively booked Tue 11:00–11:35 PT and sent a calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics). Dylan will cover the deployment and cost controls; Karthik will join for the technical deep-dive if we need it.

Quick ask: Karthik is traveling to EMEA that morning and I just realized his calendar shows a field meeting overlapping the first 15 minutes. He can join from 11:15 PT onward, and Dylan can open the session and handle the first 20 minutes. Would that work for you both?

If you prefer a single uninterrupted block with the infra lead present, we can move to Thu 2pm PT instead — open slots: Thu 02:00–02:45 PT. Tell me which you prefer and I’ll update the invite.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

One small request: can you shift the meeting to 11:05–11:40 PT so Karthik still gets 25 minutes when he drops in at 11:15? No strong preference if it complicates your team's calendars.

Peter

Thanks for the quick replies, all. Plan below — keeping it tight so everyone gets the pieces they need: 

- New confirmed time: Tue 11:05–11:40 PT (updated invite sent). (attachment: calendar_invite.ics)
- Agenda (25–30 min core + 5–10 min Q&A):
  * 11:05–11:15 — Dylan: rollout pattern and cost-control levers (batching, cache, quant profiles)
  * 11:15–11:30 — Karthik: deployment/infra details, data isolation options for private deployments
  * 11:30–11:40 — Vanessa + Lina: procurement items, mutual next steps
- Mutual Action Plan attached (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) with milestones and owners; please flag anything missing.

If Karthik runs into travel connectivity issues, Dylan will cover his section and we’ll follow up with a short tech write-up. Thanks for being flexible — see you Tue.

— Vanessa Ortiz
